steps.en: OCMS accepts PLUS's go-ahead to revive
steps.id: OCMS menerima persetujuan revive dari PLUS

steps.en: The request is checked again before reviving
Revival can close more than what was asked
steps.id: Revival bisa menutup lebih banyak dari yang diminta
steps.why_en: Without a suspension number, every active suspension on the notice is revived, not just the asked type.
steps.why_id: Tanpa nomor suspension, semua suspension aktif di notice di-revive, bukan hanya tipe yang diminta.

steps.en: PLUS is told the revival result for each notice
steps.id: PLUS diberi tahu hasil revival tiap notice
